versions.line: When you press Release it seconds after a task asks, while it is still finishing
The panel and the bar above the prompt redraw themselves far less often with nothing new
The banner at the top of the README shows the octopus in 3D, built from cubes and holding task cards
The panel no longer lets you scroll far past its cards
When you answer a question in your own words in the box above the chat, only the big Send button shows now
Check now in Config shows a newer version right under the press, with its Update button (Download
claudopus.ai has a new home page
A click on a button no longer goes missing because the panel was drawn again around it
A release now runs its checks on this Mac while GitHub runs its own, instead of one after the other
Removes a link to a local folder that an earlier release took in by mistake
A task that ends its step to wait for its helpers, or for something it asked Claudopus to start it again for
A job the chat can state clearly now goes to a fresh task on Sonnet with written instructions, by itself
The watcher that brings Claudopus back names the setting your copy really has when Claudopus is loaded…
Claudopus stays on: Claude's engine switches off an add-on that keeps its shared helper busy for five seconds
A helper or task that finished while Claudopus was out of the chat is now ended on its card when Claudopus…
Claudopus no longer makes macOS show "Keychain Not Found" when it runs in a home folder that has no keychain
Panel buttons answer clicks again with many tasks at work
When you answer in your own words above the chat, or paste a key or give a response there
Every background task, small task and helper now has the tool to ask Claudopus to wake it for a file
A task's card no longer says "2 commands have ended" above commands still working
A run one task leaves going is shown on the card of the task whose command started it
No task or helper can start a command whose only job is to wait, whatever shape it takes
Tasks, checks and helpers now start with only the tools their work takes
A command's line no longer counts "nothing printed for 10s, 15s…" while it is quiet for a few seconds
The battery card shows what the whole Mac really draws on battery, from the battery's own voltage and current
A box asking for a key has no field of its own in the panel any more
When a task's own command ends (finished, failed or stopped), Claudopus wakes the task at once
Plainer words everywhere
If a task stops partway through a step without a report (because the app restarted
Every command on a card now has a short plain line under it
